title: fix(models): list each Claude CLI model once in the model picker
body:
Related: #153707, #82546, #166361

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: the Control UI model picker lists every Claude model twice, both labelled "Claude CLI · native", after `openclaw onboard` sets up Claude CLI. `openclaw models list` without a running Gateway shows the same duplicates.

## User Impact

People who chose Claude CLI during onboarding now see each Claude model once: the configured `anthropic/*` row, which keeps its alias, its Default tag and the Claude CLI route label. API rows and Claude CLI rows stay separate, and `claude-cli/*` models you haven't configured (for example Haiku 4.5) still appear. Standalone `openclaw models list --refresh` lists the same rows as the picker.

## Why This Change Was Made

Onboarding pins each `anthropic/claude-*` model to `agentRuntime: claude-cli`. That pin is deliberate: without it, gateway turns fell through to Anthropic API billing (#82546, #84374), and Doctor canonicalizes `claude-cli/*` refs to `anthropic/*` plus the pin. The bundled Claude CLI catalog still publishes `claude-cli/<same model>`, so `models.list` returned two rows for one model on one route.

The `models.list` read (shared by `models.list`, `chat.metadata` and `openclaw models list`) now drops a `<cli-runtime>/<model>` row when the canonical `<modelProvider>/<model>` row is published on that runtime **and** config pins it there (`resolveModelRuntimePolicy`).

### Twin routes come from the catalog owner's registry

Which rows are twins is plugin policy: the CLI backend `modelProvider` bindings and the provider's catalog model id (`resolveProviderModelCatalogId`). Both are resolved from the same registry that decides availability:

- `createModelCatalogDecisions` exposes the CLI backend bindings it already resolves from the owner's `pluginRegistry` as `cliRuntimeBindings`.
- `resolveCliRuntimeTwinRoute` runs during preparation, inside `prepareEntry`, which runs in the owner's registry scope. It maps a `claude-cli/*` row to its canonical provider, resolves the catalog model id, and reads the config pin with the runtime id normalized (so a padded or mixed-case ` Claude-CLI ` pin still matches).
- The read path stays a pure projection. `omitCliRuntimeAliasTwins` only compares the prepared twin routes with each row's own `agentRuntime`; it calls no plugin or registry code. This keeps the Gateway and the standalone CLI (whose ambient registry differs from the owner's, see #166361) on the same answer.

### Selection policies keep the alias

A `claude-cli/*` row stays when some selection policy allows it but not its `anthropic/*` twin. The policies checked are the agent's manual model policy and every `gateway.roles.definitions[*].modelPolicy`, prepared once with the owner's manifest metadata. So an operator role or agent policy that allows only `claude-cli/*` still sees those rows and can select them.

These are left alone too:
- canonical rows on Claude CLI only because of a session runtime override. Choosing that row (or Default) resets to the configured route, so the CLI twin is still a different choice;
- rows whose canonical twin runs on another runtime, such as the API route;
- the `all` inventory view.

No selected-row exception is needed. Session display identity already maps CLI runtime refs to their canonical provider (`resolveSessionDisplayModelIdentityRefCached`, `src/gateway/session-utils-model.ts`), so a session on `claude-cli/claude-opus-5` renders as `anthropic/claude-opus-5` and the picker checks that row.

This keeps #153707's invariant (API and Claude CLI routes stay distinguishable) and removes the second copy of the same route. The CLI wizard picker already hides CLI runtime providers (`createModelPickerVisibleProviderPredicate`); only `models.list` was missing the canonical collapse.

## Evidence

Isolated macOS run on this head (4d4b7cfabc2) and on origin/main (2beca62e67b), both built with `pnpm build`. State, config and `HOME` were under /tmp, the Gateway had its own port, and there was no Anthropic API key. Config came from the real `openclaw onboard --non-interactive --auth-choice anthropic-cli`, with Claude Code logged in through a copied credentials file in an isolated `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. Before and after use the same state.

Gateway `models.list`, Claude rows:

| view | origin/main | this head |
|---|---|---|
| `configured` | 10 `anthropic/*` on `claude-cli` + 11 `claude-cli/*` | 10 `anthropic/*` on `claude-cli` + `claude-cli/claude-haiku-4-5`, `claude-cli/claude-mythos-5` |
| `default` | 10 `anthropic/*` on `claude-cli` + 11 `claude-cli/*` | 10 `anthropic/*` on `claude-cli` + `claude-cli/claude-haiku-4-5`, `claude-cli/claude-mythos-5` |
| `all` | 10 `anthropic/*` + 12 `claude-cli/*` | 10 `anthropic/*` + 12 `claude-cli/*` (unchanged) |

Standalone `openclaw models list --refresh --json` (same state, `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT` unset, no Gateway running), Claude rows:

| | origin/main | this head |
|---|---|---|
| `anthropic/*` | 10 rows, all `available: true` on `claude-cli` | 10 rows, all `available: true` on `claude-cli` |
| `claude-cli/*` | 11 rows | `claude-haiku-4-5`, `claude-mythos-5` |
| runs matching | 5 of 5 | 3 of 3 |

Every `claude auth status` probe in these runs exited 0 (0.13–2.1 s).

Control UI model picker:

| | origin/main | this head |
|---|---|---|
| search "opus 5.5" | 2 rows (Default row plus a second "Claude CLI · native" copy) | 1 row (the Default row) |
| search "sonnet 5" | 4 rows for two models | 2 rows |
| unfiltered groups | Anthropic 10 / Claude CLI 11 | Anthropic 10 / Claude CLI 2 |

Search "opus 5.5":

| origin/main | this head |
|---|---|
| ![origin/main: Claude Opus 5.5 listed twice on the Claude CLI route](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3c6f10fd-8c3e-48f2-9247-f2fd409d59aa) | ![this head: Claude Opus 5.5 listed once](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8b7cf849-b292-42cd-81e0-803cd8d16c80) |

Search "sonnet 5":

| origin/main | this head |
|---|---|
| ![origin/main: Sonnet 5 and Sonnet 5.5 each listed twice](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/339dc319-8c80-45fc-a0e7-3241506e122d) | ![this head: Sonnet 5 and Sonnet 5.5 listed once](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1b0001ca-61fd-43d7-8a2f-602d2e8c7aca) |

Tests:
- `list.prepared-catalog.test.ts`: the real `openclaw models list` command with a standalone owner whose registry alone has Claude CLI. It lists `anthropic/claude-opus-5` and `claude-cli/claude-haiku-4-5`, without the `claude-cli/claude-opus-5` twin.
- `models-list-result.plugin-runtime.test.ts`: Gateway `buildModelsListResult` with an empty active registry and Claude CLI only in the owner's registry. Configured and default views drop the twin; a role allowing only `claude-cli/*` and an agent `modelPolicy` allowing only `claude-cli/*` keep it.
- `model-runtime-aliases.test.ts`: twin-rule boundary table. Kept: a canonical row on Claude CLI only through a session override, an API-routed canonical row, and their CLI twins; a padded, mixed-case runtime pin (` Claude-CLI `) still collapses; a role allowing only Claude CLI rows keeps them.
- Red/green: both owner-registry tests fail when the collapse reads the ambient registry at read time, and pass on this head. The role and agent-policy cases fail without the selection-policy rule and pass now.
- On this head: `tsgo:core` and `tsgo:test:src` pass; 474 vitest tests pass across `model-runtime-aliases`, `models-list-result.*`, `models.test`, `models.prepared`, `models-list.*`, `chat-metadata-*`, `model-discovery-policy` and `commands/models/list.*`. `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` fails only the full-tree dead-export scan (7 unused exports in `src/agents/auth-profiles.runtime.ts`, untouched here), which fails the same way on origin/main 2beca62e67b.

Known and unchanged:
- `anthropic/claude-opus-4-7`, `-4-6` and `claude-sonnet-4-6` already showed raw ids on main, because the Anthropic API catalog has no entries for them without an API key.

## Bounded cost

- Twin routes are resolved once per catalog entry during preparation, which already runs per entry: a binding lookup, a config runtime-policy lookup and a catalog-id lookup. Role model policies are prepared once per prepared result, alongside the catalog; reads reuse them.
- Each read makes two passes over the already-projected rows: one map build and one filter. Only `claude-cli/*` rows whose canonical twin is listed on the same runtime check the selection policies.
- No new state, config or protocol change, and no new warnings or messages. The `all` view skips the work.

Test wall time on this head: locally with `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1` (transform is 72–92% of each), and the Vitest duration in CI run 37568557325 (shard wall time in parentheses):

| file | tests | local | CI |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src/agents/model-runtime-aliases.test.ts` | 23 | 18.9 s | 6.8 s (9.5 s) |
| `src/commands/models/list.prepared-catalog.test.ts` | 18 | 21.0 s | 15.2 s (17.1 s) |
| `src/gateway/server-methods/models-list-result.plugin-runtime.test.ts` | 15 | 23.8 s | 7.6 s (8.9 s) |

LOC: production +118/-13, docs +5/-2, tests +184/-16.
